title: Killer Bee pack manifest (killerbee.yaml)
description: Editor-time contract for the L1 manifest. The runtime authority is `killerbee validate` (killerbee/validate.py) — this schema exists so a contributor's editor flags mistakes before the CLI does. Deliberate divergences, all STRICTER than the loader: (1) unknown keys are rejected everywhere to catch typos, while the loader ignores unknown manifest keys; (2) channels accept only the canonical dashed UUID form, while the loader accepts every form Python's uuid.UUID parses; (3) falsy scalars where a mapping belongs (compat: [], profile: 0) are rejected here, while the loader silently coerces them to {} (the `or {}` at loader.py:162 and :227). What no schema can check: that persona files exist, that their frontmatter parses, that team members name real personas, and that names are unique — run `uv run python -m killerbee validate packs/<name>` for the full contract.

name.description: Pack slug. Grammar of the persona d-tag on the relay (buzz-relay handlers/ingest.rs:1130-1148 @ ed4b3e7a); also becomes directory and file names, so Windows reserved device names are refused.

version.description: Pack version, semver X.Y.Z with optional pre-release suffix.

license.description: SPDX identifier. A pack without a license is not distributable.

buzz_commit.description: Full 40-hex commit of block/buzz every citation and format in the pack was verified against.

file.description: Path to the .persona.md, relative to the pack directory. Native Buzz format: YAML frontmatter + markdown body; the body IS the system prompt. Keep Killer Bee keys OUT of it — the upstream frontmatter parser is deny_unknown_fields (buzz-persona persona.rs:174-176) and one extra key is a fatal error there.

profile.description: Scutellata response-threshold profile. Compiles to native snapshot fields (docs/PROFILE-COMPILATION.md); it never travels inside .persona.md or the snapshot.

propagation.description: Catalog metadata only — compiles to no runtime field, and the docs say so out loud.

channels.description: Either exactly ["all"] (or omit the key entirely — same meaning) or a list of channel UUIDs. An empty list is refused as ambiguous, and mixing "all" with UUIDs is refused.

id.description: Becomes {id}.team.json / {id}.team.png file names. Stricter than the upstream team d-tag on purpose: ':' is legal upstream but illegal in Windows file names (DECISIONS D-023).

members.description: Persona names (the frontmatter `name`, not the file path). Each must exist among this pack's personas — a cross-reference the schema cannot check; `killerbee validate` does.
